# CodeBasics

> > Free, interactive programming courses covering web development, backend systems, and functional programming languages with hands-on coding practice.

CodeBasics is a comprehensive learning platform offering 100% free online programming courses for beginners. The platform features interactive lessons, a built-in code editor, and structured curricula across multiple programming languages including JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, PHP, Elixir, and more.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- HTML
- CSS
- PHP
- Elixir
- Web Development
- Programming Fundamentals
- Interactive Learning
- Functional Programming
- Backend Development
- Beginner-Friendly
- Free Courses
- Syntax Basics
- Coding Practice

## Core Programming Languages

- [Learn JavaScript: Online Course for Free](https://code-basics.com/languages/javascript): JavaScript course: 72 free lessons covering fundamentals with interactive coding environment
- [Free Online Python Course for Beginners: 72 lessons](https://code-basics.com/languages/python): Python course: 72 free lessons with exercises for programming fundamentals and syntax basics
- [Learn the HTML: 100% Free Course of the Programming](https://code-basics.com/languages/html): HTML course: free interactive tutorials covering web markup fundamentals and HTML5 basics
- [Learning for Beginners: Online & Completely Free](https://code-basics.com/languages/css): CSS course: 33 free lessons on web design, styling, and responsive design fundamentals
- [Learn PHP Online in 25 Hours](https://code-basics.com/languages/php): PHP course: 72 free lessons covering backend development and programming fundamentals

## Functional & Advanced Languages

- [Elixir Basics](https://code-basics.com/languages/elixir): Elixir course: free lessons on functional programming, syntax, data types and flow control
- [What is Haskell, and What is It Used For?](https://code-basics.com/blog_posts/what-is-haskell-and-what-is-it-used-for): Article on Haskell: functional programming features, use cases, and real-world applications

## Language Guides & Comparisons

- [What is Kotlin, and What is It Used For?](https://code-basics.com/blog_posts/what-is-kotlin-and-what-is-it-used-for): Article on Kotlin: overview of features, Android development uses, and comparison with Java
- [What is C++ Programming Language?](https://code-basics.com/blog_posts/what-is-c-plus-plus-programming-language): Article on C++: syntax, applications, evolution, and systems programming capabilities
